evidence.observation: Stable monotonic column profile, gradual mild warming; no excursions
Single one-sample drop to 0 at k=19, recovered at k=20 — transient switch chatter
Reflux and distillate flows steady (~0.11/0.38 L/h), ratio ~4.5-5.5
Pressure ~495 mbar and dP steady within noise
Reboiler reads ~423 °C, implausibly high vs column temps — likely thermocouple scaling, not a process change

args.missing_evidence: A composition/GC measurement of distillate and bottoms; confirmation of T701 calibration and LS701 switch integrity.
